merchant/30517.htm.text: Armor Merchant Shari: Psst, take a look at these items... Too expensive? Don't you know these Dwarven-crafted items are sold at a premium in other places? What a bunch of country bumpkins...

links.text: Ask about the local lord and tax rate.

merchant/30517-1.htm.text: Armor Merchant Shari: Can I sell you something, sir? Just tell me what you want.

merchant/30517-pk.htm.text: Armor Merchant Shari: Ahem, my name is Shari. They say it's not an appropriate name for a girl, but I'm proud of it. I was an orphan, but I'm pretty successful now, having my own shop. When I first started working for this store, many people were jealous of my talent. But I won them over with my pe…

Q00005_MinersFavor/30517-02.html.text: Trader Shari: I gave you a sack of Boomboom Powder, right? Hurry and take it to Miner Bolter. And be sure not to get it near any open flame, or getting Bolter's reward will be the least of your worries!

Q00005_MinersFavor/30517-01.html.text: Trader Shari: Bolter sent you, eh? Lessee here...oh, he ordered some Boomboom Powder a few days ago. Last time he used too much while trying to blast a new mine entrance and singed his beard! Hopefully he'll be more careful with this batch. Here you go: 1 sack of Boomboom Powder. Please don't drop …

Q00221_TestimonyOfProsperity/30517-01.ht.text: Trader Shari: Yes, I know I need to pay my dues . But...well, my sales are way down lately. What can I do? I can't very well pay if I don't have the money, can I? I suppose I could borrow the money... In fact, I just took out a loan I was hoping to use to buy some new inventory. Oh, well...take it!…

Q00417_PathOfTheScavenger/30517-02.html.text: Trader Shari: Oh, it's finally arrived! Thank you a! Here is the payment... (Tsk, tsk...poor fool, to be victimized by Mion!) What's that? Was that out loud? Oh, I was just talking to myself, friend -- just...figuring out some shelving issues...

Q00417_PathOfTheScavenger/30517-03.html.text: Trader Shari: Give the payment to Mion, please. Be sure to say how grateful I am. Well, you'd best be on your way. Good day!
